text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bearing the burden of countless hopes, Mejiro Ryan grows stronger each day as she prepares for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no doubting the sheer amount of effort she's put into ensuring her own victory. Mejiro Bright, too, has no doubt that Mejiro Ryan will win the upcoming race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Ines Fujin intends to live up to the hopes of all those who see their dreams in her. No matter how formidable her foe, she can't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Burning with the desire to live up to her fans' expectations and dream alongside them, Ines steps onto the track. The Takarazuka Kinen is about to begin!
